title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta17

## Sound level control

Adds a capability-driven Sound level number entity for mowers that expose
`volumeSetting` in vendor `set_list`.

H215 field evidence showed:

- maximum app volume -> `volumeSetting="100"`;
- lowering the native-app slider to roughly 10% -> `volumeSetting="12"`;
- `soundAdjust` remained `4`;
- `soundSwitch` remained `"1"`.

This identifies `volumeSetting` as the actual continuous volume control rather
than either of the other sound-related fields.

The Home Assistant entity is:

- range: 0..100%;
- step: 1%;
- slider mode;
- exposed only when `volumeSetting` is present.

Initial wire encoding intentionally mirrors the vendor field type observed in
both raw captures:

- mower/device write: decimal string, e.g. `"12"`;
- cloud persistence write: decimal string, e.g. `"12"`.

The beta16 per-setting 15 s / 75 s persistence trace and device-command outcome
diagnostics are reused for field validation. If the mower later proves to require
a different device/cloud representation, this can be corrected per setting
without changing the entity contract.

No Map Card update is required.
